turns.text:
ok sunita texted me abt th vendor sheet, pasting. can you make my reply sound less like a robot wrote it

her msg: "hey did you get to update the vendor sheet?? also my friend at Harrowgate says the hiring team is still going thru second rounds, how did your interview go? tell mom i said hi"

my draft: "Yes, I updated the wedding vendor spreadsheet for April at dinner tonight. Interview went ok, I'll hear by mid-December. Sunday call went fine, mom promised not to ask till December. Also just prepped four containers of rajma and rice so I'm set for the week."

Your draft is clear but a bit like a status report. Here's a version that sounds more like a text to a sibling:

"Yep, the vendor sheet is all updated, we did it at dinner tonight so it's current for April. Interview went ok, I think. They told me I'll hear by mid-December. Sunday call went fine too, mom promised not to ask until December, so I'm choosing to believe her. Also just prepped four containers of rajma and rice, so I'm set for the week. Will tell mom you said hi!"

I added a small joke and a line responding to her "tell mom I said hi." Want a shorter or more casual version?
lol th joke is good. too long tho, tldr version pls

Short version:

"Vendor sheet's updated, did it at dinner. Interview went ok, hear by mid-December. Sunday call went fine, mom promised not to ask till then 💀 Four containers of rajma and rice prepped, I'm set. Will tell mom hi!"

I kept the emoji since you used a similar tone in your draft. Remove it if it doesn't fit how you text her.
You're welcome! Hope the interview news lands well and the week goes smoothly.
